external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store whose own identity provider vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group membership changes to the identity broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by a franchise that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, obtains group membership changes, signs tokens, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses the token's groups to authorize changing prices and voiding transactions across every store.
processes.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what that log records, whether it covers the franchise route, or whether the directory or the log are encrypted where they sit.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in through the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: franchise sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague is signed in through the broker using a vouch from the franchise identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the franchise identity provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token carrying a colleague's staff ID and groups.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and group list

data_flows.name: use token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents the token to the store admin console to perform authorized actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.
data_flows.notes: Every application takes the token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
data_flows.data_description: token and requests to change prices or void transactions

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the broker's signing key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker receives overnight group membership and leaver changes from the HR system.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.data_description: group membership and colleague status changes

data_flows.name: maintain directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains its directory of colleagues and group memberships.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker reads the signing key from the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state what the audit log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network on which the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home
trust_boundaries.description: The home location from which colleagues may sign in using their own devices.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise environment whose colleagues are allowed to sign in through their own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.
